annotation.title_clean: U.S. Leadership in AI: A Plan for Federal Engagement in Developing Technical Standards and Related Tools
annotation.title_en: U.S. Leadership in AI: A Plan for Federal Engagement in Developing Technical Standards and Related Tools
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: NIST plan prepared under Executive Order 13859 setting out how US federal agencies should engage in AI technical standards and related tools. It identifies nine standards focus areas, including safety, risk management and trustworthiness, and recommends coordination, research, public-private partnership and international engagement to sustain US AI leadership.
key_provisions_or_claims: Identifies nine AI standards focus areas: terminology, data, human interactions, metrics, networking, performance testing, safety, risk management, trustworthiness.
NSTC ML/AI Subcommittee should designate a Standards Coordinator.
Agencies should engage at levels from monitoring to leading, prioritizing open, consensus-based standards.
Promote research on trustworthiness metrics, data sets, testbeds and tools.
Strengthen public-private partnerships and international engagement to advance US-aligned standards.
